t: Add track.jsonl interruption detection to wakeup — surface incomplete sessions with turn number and timestamp
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md Step 7 (Display Briefing) and Step 8 (Initialize Session). 2. Read a recent track.jsonl file (WAI-Spoke/sessions/session-*/track.jsonl) to see the final entry format — does it have a 'phase: review' or 'completed' marker? 3. Read WAI-State.json _session_state.last_session_id and track_path to find the previous session's track.
execute: 1. Add to wai.md Step 7 (before briefing display): read the previous session's track.jsonl (from _session_state.track_path). Parse the last JSON line. 2. Check if the last entry has phase='review' (normal closeout) or if the track ends abruptly (no review phase, truncated JSON). 3. If interrupted: surface in briefing under Context Health: 'Previous session interrupted at Turn {N} ({timestamp}). Last phase: {phase}. Run /wai-green-light to review recovery options.' 4. If normal closeout: no additional output. 5. Sync wai.md to all targets: templates/spoke/skills/wai/, WAI-Spoke/commands/, WAI-Spoke/skills/wai/.
verify: 1. Simulate: truncate a track.jsonl to remove the final review entry, run wakeup — interruption message appears. 2. Normal track with review phase — no interruption message. 3. Missing track file — graceful handling (no crash, note 'previous track not found').

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Add interruption detection to wakeup by validating the previous session's track.jsonl final entry
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not implementing full recovery — just detection and surfacing. Recovery is handled by /wai-green-light.
